articles.summary: Capri Holdings Limited (NYSE: CPRI) today announced that it plans to report its second quarter fiscal 2027 financial results on Friday, October 30, 2026, at approximately 7:00 a.m. ET. The Company also plans to hold a conference call to discuss its financial results the same day at 10:00 a.m. ET. Those who wish to participate in the call may do so by dialing (877) 704-4453 or (201) 389-0920 for international callers, conference ID 13758774. A live webcast of the conference call will also be available on the Company’s website, www.capriholdings.com . In addition, a replay of the call will be available shortly after the conclusion of the call and remain available until November 6, 2026. To access the telephone replay, listeners should dial (844) 512-2921 or (412) 317-6671 for international callers. The access code for the replay is 13758774. A replay of the webcast will also be available on the Company’s website within two hours of the conclusion of the call. About Capri Holdings

articles.summary: Revenue, Operating Income and Earnings Per Share Exceed Expectations Company Increases Full Year Outlook Capri Holdings Limited (NYSE:CPRI), a global fashion luxury group, today announced its financial results for the second quarter of Fiscal 2027 ended September 26, 2026. Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Highlights from Continuing Operations Revenue decreased 5.5% on a reported basis and 4.9% in constant currency Operating margin was 1.2%; adjusted operating margin was 3.8% Earnings per share were $0.25; adjusted earnings per share were $0.42 John D. Idol, the Company's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, said, “We are encouraged by the momentum building at both Michael Kors and Jimmy Choo. Throughout the second quarter, trends improved sequentially each month across both of our luxury houses, reflecting the actions we have taken to sharpen our product assortments, elevate brand desirability and strengthen consumer engagement.
